case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel’s central location, rooftop and city views, attentive staff, varied breakfasts and cleanliness. Recurring negatives included street noise, signage/wayfinding in corridors, and a range of maintenance or in‑room issues (bathrooms needing updates, occasional clogged drains, AC or power/socket problems, limited TV channels). Feedback on bed linens and towels was mixed, and a few noted renovation-related arrangements such as breakfast reservations.
